description: This file defines an abstract base class 'WebsocketService' providing websocket connection management with features like automatic reconnection, exponential backoff, message sending with retries, and error handling. It serves as a foundational component for websocket-based services, meant to be subclassed with specific connection and message handling logic.

classes.name: WebsocketService
classes.description: An abstract base class providing websocket connection management with automatic reconnection, error handling, and message exchange features. Designed for subclassing to implement service-specific behaviors.

methods.name: __init__(self, *, reconnect_on_error: bool = True, **kwargs)
methods.description: Initializes the WebsocketService with optional automatic reconnection on error.

methods.name: bool _verify_connection(self)
methods.description: Checks if the websocket connection is active and responsive using a ping.

methods.name: bool _reconnect_websocket(self, attempt_number: int)
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect the websocket and verifies the connection.

methods.name: bool _try_reconnect( self, max_retries: int = 3, report_error: Optional[Callable[[ErrorFrame], Awaitable[None]]] = None, )
methods.description: Retries websocket reconnection with exponential backoff, for a configurable number of attempts.

methods.name: send_with_retry(self, message, report_error: Callable[[ErrorFrame], Awaitable[None]])
methods.description: Sends a message with logic to reconnect and retry if the initial send fails.

methods.name: _receive_task_handler(self, report_error: Callable[[ErrorFrame], Awaitable[None]])
methods.description: Continuously receives websocket messages, handling errors and reconnecting as needed.

methods.name: _connect(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to connect to the websocket service (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: _disconnect(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to disconnect from the websocket service (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: _connect_websocket(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to establish the websocket connection (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: _disconnect_websocket(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to close the websocket connection (to be implemented by subclasses).

methods.name: _receive_messages(self)
methods.description: Abstract method to handle receiving and processing websocket messages (to be implemented by subclasses).

ctags.name: _try_reconnect
ctags.signature: ( self, max_retries: int = 3, report_error: Optional[Callable[[ErrorFrame], Awaitable[None]]] = None, )

ctags.name: send_with_retry
ctags.pattern: /^    async def send_with_retry(self, message, report_error: Callable[[ErrorFrame], Awaitable[None/
